name: Ola
tagline: Former Indian ride-hailing leader, now shrinking under zero-commission pressure
facts: 2010, Mumbai; Bhavish Aggarwal and Ankit Bhati
ANI Technologies (Ola Consumer, ex-Ola Cabs), unlisted
FY25 ₹662 cr standalone, double FY24's ₹329 cr
Sister cos: Ola Electric (listed), Krutrim AI
Prep began May 2026 despite falling revenue

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Build mobility for a billion Indians: affordable, accessible rides across cabs, autos and bikes.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Ola Consumer as an India-first super app spanning mobility, payments, food via ONDC and Ola Maps.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Shift to SaaS-style driver subscriptions (0% commission) to win supply back from Rapido and Uber.

strategy.label: India-only focus
strategy.text: Exited UK, Australia, New Zealand in 2024; in-house Ola Maps and Krutrim cloud to cut costs.

strategy.label: Lesson
strategy.text: Founder attention split across Ola Electric and Krutrim let a focused Rapido out-execute Ola on price.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Is a zero-commission subscription a moat, or a race to the bottom that removes Ola's revenue?

customers.who: Office-goers using autos and bikes daily
customers.pain: Cancellations, AC and cash disputes, long pickup waits
customers.why: Low fares under zero-commission; wide auto and bike coverage

customers.pain: Car quality, driver refusals, unpredictable fares
customers.why: Price, Ola Rentals and Outstation options, habit from earlier years

customers.pain: High commissions, incentive cuts, low ride volumes
customers.why: Keep 100% fare for a flat daily or monthly pass

customers.pain: Fare caps, safety, driver welfare compliance

products.name: Ola Mini / Prime
products.desc: App-based cab rides across price tiers

products.name: Ola Auto and Bike
products.desc: Autorickshaw and bike-taxi rides for short trips

products.name: Rentals / Outstation
products.desc: Hourly packages and intercity cab trips

portfolio.north_star: Completed rides per week with low cancellation
portfolio.key_metrics: Daily rides, active drivers, subscription renewals, pickup ETA, share vs Rapido
portfolio.guardrails: Cancellation rate, safety incidents, driver net earnings per hour

products.name: Ola Maps
products.desc: In-house mapping replacing Google Maps, also sold to developers

products.name: Ola Money / Pay
products.desc: Wallet and UPI payments inside the app

portfolio.key_metrics: Pass revenue, pass renewal rate, Maps API usage, cost per ride
portfolio.guardrails: Driver churn after pass expiry, payment failures

products.name: Ola Electric
products.desc: Listed EV scooter maker; share fell from ~49% to ~6.5%

products.name: Krutrim
products.desc: AI and cloud venture; ~90% of revenue from Ola group firms

portfolio.north_star: Group synergies without draining Ola Consumer focus
portfolio.key_metrics: EVs on Ola fleet, Krutrim cost savings

rows.how: Flat passes (~₹67/day) for unlimited rides, no commission
Platform or convenience fees on bookings

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Shift from commissions to subscriptions cut reported revenue 42% in FY25; most income is service fees.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Under 0% commission, drivers are the payers; riders pay fares directly to drivers.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Subscription revenue per driver capped and low; losses doubled to ₹662 cr as rides shrank.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Win back supply, EV fleets, Tier-2 autos, Maps monetisation, IPO capital.

bullets.label: Valuation lesson
bullets.text: Vanguard mark of ~$70M (99% below peak) shows investors price Ola as a fading No.3.

friction: Drivers cancel or demand extra cash
Long waits as active driver pool shrank
Advance tip prompts flagged by government
Inconsistent car quality and AC refusals

competitors.label: Leader
competitors.text: Rapido: largest by rides, $3B valuation, subscription pioneer

competitors.label: Global
competitors.text: Uber: 225 Indian cities, ₹2,921 cr fresh capital

competitors.label: Open / co-op
competitors.text: Namma Yatri, Bharat Taxi cooperative (~11% cheaper), inDrive

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Brand recall, wide auto/bike network, in-house Maps cost advantage

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Cash burn, state aggregator rules, EV mandates, founder distraction

news.label: Sep 2026
news.text: Centre asks Ola, Uber, Rapido to remove advance tipping; Chandigarh bars aggregators.

news.label: Jun 2026
news.text: Vanguard marks Ola Consumer down to ~$70M, 99% below 2021 peak.

news.label: May 2026
news.text: Late FY25 filing: revenue -42%, loss doubles; Ola begins IPO preparation.

news.label: Watch
news.text: Can Ola list, or will it be acquired or merged as Rapido consolidates?

sources: RoC filings via Moneycontrol, FE, Mint, Inc42; Vanguard SEC filing coverage; Morning Context; press 2025-26. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
